physicalNotes: Radius 0.25 solar radii from Morin et al., arXiv:0808.1423, Table 1: radius 0.25 solar radii (theoretical radius; R sin i = 0.23(1)) (https://arxiv.org/abs/0808.1423): 173,925 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.25 solar masses from Morin et al., arXiv:0808.1423, Table 1: mass 0.25 solar masses (https://arxiv.org/abs/0808.1423); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 3210 K from Pecaut & Mamajek (2013, ApJS 208, 9), the online table's version 2022.04.16, row M4V, for SIMBAD's spectral type M4.0Ve: Teff (https://www.pas.rochester.edu/~emamajek/EEM_dwarf_UBVIJHK_colors_Teff.txt). Spin inclination 60 degrees and rotation period 0.405 d from Morin et al., arXiv:0808.1423, Table 1: rotation period 0.405 d and an axis 60 degrees from the line of sight, the values its magnetic maps were made with (https://arxiv.org/abs/0808.1423). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
